other_conditions: Applicant must be a retired journalist.
Must have worked full-time for 20 years in one of the posts: teacher, assistant teacher, reporter, photographer, proofreader, or news correspondent.
If terminally ill or physically disabled, 10 years of journalism experience is sufficient.
Annual family income must not exceed ₹20,000.
Gratuity and pension from previous companies must not exceed ₹30,000.
Income in any year of employment must not exceed ₹50,000.
Two completed application forms must be submitted.
A receipt or acknowledgment from the department is required.
